test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Abide
solution: The correct answer is: **Reject**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Abide **means to accept or follow a rule, decision, or agreement. (किसी नियम, निर्णय या समझौते को स्वीकार करना या उसका पालन करना) • **Reject **means to refuse to accept or consider something. (किसी बात को स्वीकार करने या विचार करने से इंकार करना) • The two words are antonyms of each other. • **For example**: *The company had to reject his proposal because it did not abide by the company's policies.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Dwell**, means to live in a particular place. (किसी विशेष स्थान पर रहना) • **Anticipate**, means to expect or predict something. (किसी चीज़ की आशा या भविष्यवाणी करना) • **Endure**, means to suffer or withstand something unpleasant. (किसी अप्रिय चीज़ को सहना या सहना) 196:T8fb, The correct answer is: "**received his birthday present at dusk**."
